summary: Solowin Holdings filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a direct offering of 10,300,000 Class A ordinary shares to certain individual investors at $1.20 per share under a November 5, 2026 securities purchase agreement, for gross proceeds of about $12.36 million before expenses. No placement agent, underwriter or escrow is involved. The offer sits below the November 4 Nasdaq closing price of $1.71 and follows a 1-for-200 share consolidation effective October 29, 2026. This is an ordinary primary equity takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and post-consolidation price volatility.
